# Super GT 24h: a game played until time runs out: coins, start, the
# accelerator tapped to confirm course, car and gear (it confirms on a press,
# so holding it does not), full throttle with light steering, then the
# results, name entry (start presses) and game over, back to attract.
# MAME only sees the pedal change (its sgt24h TODO: "pedals pulse instead of
# being fixed"), so the throttle is pulsed, 3 frames on, 3 off.
# Pedal values are MAME's field values (the port reads them reversed).
